children: The U.S. October core PCE report is due next week, and markets will close for the Thanksgiving holiday. According to PANews, markets were pressured this week by a retreat in AI-related trading and persistent inflation. The Dow fell 8.02% for the week, the S&P 500 declined 8.61%, and the Nasdaq dropped 10.02%; the Dow and S&P 500 both entered corrections. Nvidia reported steady quarterly results, but its shares fell 14% on Friday, reducing its market capitalization by more than $490 billion.

title: U.S. October Core PCE Due Next Week as Markets Close for Thanksgiving
